description: Change of use of Unit 4 and 5 from Class E(a) (retail) and Class F1(a) (Cookery School) to Class F1(a) (Cookery School) and Class E(b) (Restaurant).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

-	Cover letter by Savills
-	Proposed Context Plan Drawing Number 002 Revision A
-	Proposed Plan Drawing Number 300 Revision A
-	Proposed Context Plan Drawing Number 010 Revision D
-	Ground Floor � Unit 4 and 5 Land Registry Plan Drawing Number GWC-AAM-XX-00-DR-A-02102 Revision P1
-	Unit 4-5, Gateway Central, 187 Wood Lane, London, W12 7SA by SLR Consulting Limited dated 9 June 2026
-	Operational Note 8 July 2026

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - No air-conditioning, ventilation, extraction or other external plant shall be installed on the external facade of the building or within the curtilage of the site without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. Any such equipment shall require a separate planning application detailing its design, siting, appearance, acoustic impact and method of installation.

Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the area, the character and appearance of the building, and the amenity of neighbouring occupiers from noise, vibration and disturbance, in accordance with Policies DM G7 and DC1 of the Local Plan, and Policy D14 of the London Plan.

Condition : 4 - No customers shall be on the premises in connection with the operations of the ground level use hereby approved, between the hours of midnight and 0730 the following day.

In order that noise and disturbance which may be caused by customers leaving the premises is confined to those hours when ambient noise levels and general activity are sufficiently similar to that in the surrounding area, thereby ensuring that the use does not cause demonstratable harm to surrounding residential occupiers, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan 2018.

Condition : 5 - No deliveries to customers from the premises (including deliveries undertaken by staff, third-party delivery operators or app-based delivery services) shall take place outside the hours of midnight and 0730 the following day.
�
The operator shall ensure that all delivery collections and dispatches are managed from within the premises and shall take all reasonable steps to prevent delivery drivers waiting, congregating or causing obstruction on the public highway.
�
Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, prevent noise, disturbance, obstruction and anti-social impacts associated with delivery activity, and to ensure the development operates in a manner compatible with the character and function of the town centre, in accordance with Policies DC4, DC8 and T1 of the Local Plan and Policies T6 and T7 of the London Plan.
